k1.text: On 7 February 2018, an uneasy boundary followed the Euphrates through eastern Syria.
k1.spoken: On 7 February 2018, an uneasy boundary followed the Euphrates through eastern Syria.

k2.text: At the Conoco gas plant, American special operators and Syrian Democratic Forces held the eastern bank.
k2.spoken: At the Conoco gas plant, American special operators and Syrian Democratic Forces held the eastern bank.

k3.text: That night, a pro-government column of tanks, fighting vehicles, and about 500 men moved out of Khasham, including reported Wagner personnel.
k3.spoken: That night, a pro-government column of tanks, fighting vehicles, and about 500 men moved out of Khasham, including reported Wagner personnel.

k4.text: As the column closed on the plant, its howitzers and Grad rockets opened fire across the river.
k4.spoken: As the column closed on the plant, its howitzers and Grad rockets opened fire across the river.

k5.text: American aircraft and artillery answered the call, including Raptors, Strike Eagles, a Reaper drone, a gunship, Apache helicopters, and B 52 bombers.
k5.spoken: American aircraft and artillery answered the call, including Raptors, Strike Eagles, a Reaper drone, a gunship, Apache helicopters, and B 52 bombers.

k6.text: One by one, precision strikes began tearing the advancing column apart.
k6.spoken: One by one, precision strikes began tearing the advancing column apart.

k7.text: The A C 130 circled the battlefield, sending heavy shells into the column below.
k7.spoken: The A C 130 circled the battlefield, sending heavy shells into the column below.

k8.text: American rocket artillery turned on the attacking guns and silenced their remaining batteries.
k8.spoken: American rocket artillery turned on the attacking guns and silenced their remaining batteries.

k9.text: After about four hours, the assault had collapsed. No American troops were killed.
k9.spoken: After about four hours, the assault had collapsed. No American troops were killed.
